title: 第21章 碰瓷第22章 小青蛇
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
宁知初她随手将小松鼠放在肩上，哼着小曲儿便准备打道回府。
可刚走出没几步，肩上的小团子突然支棱起毛茸茸的小脑袋，黑葡萄似的大眼睛直勾勾地盯着某个方向。
宁知初敏锐地察觉到小家伙的异样，顺着它的视线望去，指尖轻轻点了点小松鼠毛茸茸的肚皮，只只，怎么了？
小松鼠抖了抖蓬松的大尾巴，小爪子兴奋地比划着：主人主人！
那边有熟悉的果香！
很好吃很好吃的那种！
宁知初闻言眼前一亮，嘴角不自觉扬起一抹狡黠的弧度——哟，这是要捡到宝的节奏？不过她到底是个谨慎的，问道：附近有没有危险？
只只没感觉到呢！
小家伙歪着脑袋仔细感应了一番，而且距离很近很近的！
说着还张开小短手夸张地比划了个大圆圈。
好，那咱们就去看看有什么好东西。
宁知初利落地站起身，突然想到什么似的眨眨眼，不过保险起见...她变戏法似的掏出个绣着云纹的灵兽袋，在小松鼠面前晃了晃。
小松鼠立刻会意，麻溜地钻进灵兽袋里，那机灵劲儿逗得宁知初噗嗤一笑。
宁知初将小松鼠收进灵兽袋后，便悠哉悠哉地朝着小松鼠指的方向晃悠过去。
她看似漫不经心，实则神识早已悄然铺开，像一张无形的网，细细感知着周围的动静。
走了不到两刻钟，她的脚步忽然一顿，眉梢微挑——神识扫过前方不远处的杂草丛时，竟捕捉到一丝微弱的灵机波动。
她定睛看去，只见一株不起眼的小果树藏匿在茂密的杂草间，树高不过一米，枝叶稀疏，若非神识敏锐，怕是直接路过都不会注意到。
最引人注目的是，那纤细的枝头上，竟挂着三颗翠莹莹的果子，个个如婴儿拳头般大小，通体碧绿，表面泛着一层淡淡的灵光，在阳光下显得格外水灵。
宁知初唇角一扬，眼中闪过一丝兴奋：嘿，还真藏着好东西呀！
宁知初饶有兴致地打量着那株小果树，目光顺着树干往下滑，突然在树根处发现了一条通体碧青的小蛇。

那蛇一动不动地盘着，连气息都收敛得干干净净，乍一看就像条死蛇。
她挑了挑眉，神识在青蛇身上来回扫了几遍，嘴角渐渐勾起一抹玩味的笑。
故意移开神识，又突然猛地扫回去——果然捕捉到那蛇身微不可察地颤了颤。
哎呀呀，宁知初装模作样地叹了口气，声音故意放得老大，这儿怎么有条死蛇啊？看着怪可怜的~她歪着头作思考状，要不要好心给它入土为安呢？
说着还蹲下身，捡了根树枝作势要拨弄。
顿了顿又摇头晃脑道：算了算了，挖坑多累人啊。
要不...她眼睛一亮，打了个响指，干脆一把火烧了得了？又快又干净，连灰都不用埋~
content_en:
Ning Zhichu casually put the little squirrel on her shoulder, hummed a little tune and prepared to go home.
But just a few steps away, the little dumpling on his shoulders suddenly raised his furry little head, and his big black grape-like eyes stared straight in a certain direction.
Ning Zhichu was keenly aware of the little guy's strangeness. He followed its line of sight and gently tapped the little squirrel's furry belly with his fingertips. What's wrong?
The little squirrel shook its big fluffy tail and gestured excitedly with its little paws: Master, Master!
There’s a familiar fruity aroma over there!
Very delicious!
Ning Zhichu's eyes lit up when he heard this, and the corner of his mouth unconsciously raised a sly arc - Oh, is this the rhythm of picking up a treasure? But she was cautious after all and asked: Is there any danger nearby?
I just didn’t feel it!
The little guy tilted his head and sensed it carefully, and the distance was very, very close!
As he spoke, he opened his short hands and made an exaggerated gesture in a big circle.
Okay, let's go see what good stuff there is.
Ning Zhichu stood up neatly and blinked as if she suddenly thought of something, but just to be on the safe side...she took out a spirit animal bag embroidered with cloud patterns like a magic trick and waved it in front of the little squirrel.
The little squirrel immediately understood and slipped into the spirit beast bag. His cleverness made Ning Zhichu burst into laughter.
After Ning Zhichu put the little squirrel into the spirit beast bag, he leisurely wandered in the direction pointed by the little squirrel.
She seemed careless, but in fact, her consciousness had already spread out quietly, like an invisible net, carefully sensing the movements around her.
After walking for less than two-quarters of an hour, her footsteps suddenly stopped, and her eyebrows were raised slightly - when her consciousness swept through the weeds not far ahead, she actually caught a faint fluctuation of inspiration.
She looked intently and saw an inconspicuous small fruit tree hidden among the dense weeds. The tree was only one meter tall and had sparse branches and leaves. If she didn't have a keen sense of consciousness, she wouldn't even notice it if she passed by.
The most eye-catching thing is that there are three emerald green fruits hanging on the slender branches. Each one is as big as a baby's fist. They are all green and have a faint spiritual light on the surface, which looks particularly juicy in the sunlight.
Ning Zhichu raised the corners of his lips, and a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes: Hey, there is really something good hidden there!
Ning Zhichu looked at the small fruit tree with great interest, his eyes slid down the trunk, and suddenly he found a small green snake at the root of the tree.
The snake was coiled motionless, and even its breath had been restrained. At first glance, it looked like a dead snake.
She raised her eyebrows and scanned Green Snake's body several times with her consciousness, and a playful smile gradually appeared at the corner of her mouth.
He deliberately moved his consciousness away, and then suddenly swept it back - and sure enough, he caught the snake's body trembling slightly.
Oops, Ning Zhichu pretended to sigh, his voice deliberately loud, why is there a dead snake here? It looked so pitiful~ She tilted her head and thought, should she be kind enough to bury it?
As he spoke, he knelt down and picked up a branch as if to fiddle with it.
After a pause, he shook his head and said: Forget it, digging holes is so tiring.
How about...her eyes lit up, she snapped her fingers, and just set it on fire? It’s fast and clean, and you don’t even need to bury the dust~
